bibl.title: Three lists of soldiers on papyrus found in Qasr Ibrim.
bibl.seg: 141.4 P. Qasr Ibrîm Inv. 78.2.23/9a; 80.2.6/51(B) (= P. Cair. Inv. 95213) 141.5 P. Qasr Ibrîm Inv. 80.2.5/2 (= P. Cair. Inv. 95210)
Tomasz Derda, Adam Łajtar & Tomasz Płóciennik, Three lists of soldiers on papyrus found in Qasr Ibrim.
Agnieszka Tomas (ed.), Ad fines imperii Romani. Studia Thaddaeo Sarnowski septuagenario ab amicis, collegis discipulisque dedicata (Varsaviae, 2015) pp. 47-57, figg.
bibl.note: Publishes 3 lists of soldiers discovered in Qasr Ibrim during archaeological excavations carried by the Mission of the Egypt Exploration Society: 1. P. Qasr Ibrîm Inv. 80.2.6/51(B) = P. Cair. Inv. 95213. Greek list of 9 men; - 2. P. Qasr Ibrîm Inv. 78.2.23/9a (present location unknown). List of Roman names; - 3. P. Qasr Ibrîm Inv. 80.2.5/2 = P. Cair. Inv. 95210. List of 17 Roman citizens.
